name: Vol'jin
summary: Vol'jin is the chieftain of the Darkspear trolls and a master shadow hunter. Residing in Grommash Hold alongside Warchief Thrall, he acts as a trusted advisor to the Horde while working to secure his displaced people a permanent home in Durotar.

sections.title: Chieftain of the Darkspear
sections.body: Vol'jin took up leadership of the Darkspear tribe following the tragic death of his father, Sen'jin, on their ancestral island home. When sea witch-worshipping murlocs and human forces nearly destroyed the isolated tribe, Thrall's orcs intervened, forging a deep bond between the two peoples. After evacuating the ruins of their islands, Vol'jin pledged his trolls to the New Horde and brought them across the Great Sea to Kalimdor.

sections.title: Council in the Valley of Strength
sections.body: Though the Darkspear established settlements in Durotar, internal betrayals—namely the treachery of Zalazane on the Echo Isles—forced many refugees to the mainland at Sen'jin Village. Vol'jin spends much of his time inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, lending his sharp strategic counsel and shadow hunter prowess directly to Thrall. From the heart of the orcish capital, he watches over the fledgling Horde while striving to reclaim his people's rightful lands.

faq.answer: Vol'jin is the leader and chieftain of the Darkspear troll tribe. He is a skilled shadow hunter who represents his people within the Horde leadership, serving as one of Warchief Thrall's closest counselors in Orgrimmar.
Vol'jin is located in Grommash Hold, in the Valley of Wisdom within Orgrimmar, standing right beside Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: Why did the Darkspear join the Horde?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Thrall's fleet washed ashore on the Darkspear Islands. The orcs allied with the trolls against hostile humans and a fanatical murloc army. When Sen'jin fell in battle, Vol'jin honored his father's vision by pledging his tribe to Thrall and accompanying the orcs to Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why aren't the Darkspear living on their own islands?
aliases: why are trolls in senjin village
faq.answer: After settling off the coast of Durotar on the Echo Isles, Vol'jin's childhood friend and witch doctor Zalazane was driven mad by dark magic. Zalazane enslaved his fellow tribesmen, forcing Vol'jin and the surviving Darkspear to flee to the mainland at Sen'jin Village.

angles.text: Vol'jin is your chieftain, guiding the Darkspear through displacement and hardship with spiritual wisdom and tactical resolve.
Alongside Thrall, Vol'jin serves as a pillar of the New Horde, offering cunning advice and the fierce loyalty of the jungle trolls.
